source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-35), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Biodiversity and Classification) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Name the five kingdoms of Whittaker's system. Which of them contained prokaryotes?
(Whittaker ke system ki paanch kingdoms ke naam likhein. In mein se kis mein prokaryotes thay?)
blocks.explanation: Robert Whittaker (1969) ne organisms ko Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia mein taqseem kiya. Kingdom Monera mein prokaryotes thay; baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

book_ref.quote: all organisms were divided into five kingdoms i.e., Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, and Animalia

blocks.prompt:
2 On what basis did Carl Woese propose the three-domain system?
(Carl Woese ne three-domain system kis bunyad par pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1990 mein Carl Woese ne bataya ke prokaryotes ke do alag groups hain, Archaea aur Bacteria. Isi bunyad par us ne organisms ko teen domains mein taqseem kiya: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya.

book_ref.quote: suggested that there are two separate groups of prokaryotes i.e., Archaea and Bacteria

blocks.prompt:
3 What is phylogeny? What is a phylogenetic tree?
(Phylogeny kya hai? Phylogenetic tree kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organisms ke darmiyan evolutionary rishta phylogeny (nasli taalluq) kehlata hai. Jo diagram phylogeny dikhaye use phylogenetic ya evolutionary tree kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The diagram to show phylogeny, is called phylogenetic or evolutionary tree

blocks.prompt:
4 From which domain did Eukarya evolve? Give the evidence.
(Eukarya kis domain se bane? Saboot dein.)
blocks.explanation: Molecular saboot batata hai ke archaea bacteria ke bajaye eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain. Is liye Eukarya Archaea se bane, jab archaea Bacteria se alag ho chuke thay.

book_ref.quote: In other words, Eukarya evolved from Archaea

blocks.prompt:
5 Why were archaea once called archaebacteria? What does the name Archaea mean?
(Archaea ko pehle archaebacteria kyun kaha jata tha? Archaea naam ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Archaea ko shuru mein bacteria ka aik group samjha gaya, is liye archaebacteria kaha gaya. Naam Yunani lafz archaios (qadeem) se hai; yeh bohat purane zamane mein bacteria se alag hue.

book_ref.quote: Archaea were initially classified as a group of bacteria

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between the membrane lipids of archaea and of bacteria/Eukarya.
(Archaea aur bacteria/Eukarya ki membrane lipids mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein linkage aur fatty acid chains ki shakal ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, bacteria and Eukarya have membrane lipids with fatty acids attached to glycerol by ester linkages

rows: Glycerol aur fatty acid chains mein ether linkage
Glycerol aur fatty acids mein ester linkage
Membrane intehai halaat mein zyada mazboot
Membrane intehai halaat mein kam mazboot

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the cell wall of archaea made of?
(Archaea ki cell wall kis cheez se bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Archaea ki cell wall mein cellulose aur peptidoglycan nahi hote. Is ke bajaye khaas polysaccharides aur proteins hote hain; kuch archaea mein pseudopeptidoglycan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The cell walls of archaea lack cellulose and peptidoglycan

blocks.prompt:
8 Give two uses of archaea for humans.
(Insanon ke liye archaea ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Zyada tezabi/alkali mahol ke archaeans se DNA replication ke enzymes milte hain jo zyada temperature par behtareen kaam karte hain aur lab mein DNA ki tez cloning karte hain.
2. Methanogens sewage treatment mein anaerobic digestion kar ke biogas banate hain. (Neez: acidophilic archaea kachi dhaat se sona, cobalt aur copper nikalte hain.)

book_ref.quote: These enzymes can work best at high temperatures and allow rapid cloning of DNA in laboratory

blocks.prompt:
9 Name the major groups of archaea with one feature of each.
(Archaea ke bare groups ke naam aur har aik ki aik khususiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Methanogens: methane ko metabolic by-product ke taur par banate hain.
Halobacteria: bohat namkeen mahol mein rehte hain.
Thermococci: garam mahol mein milte hain.
Thaumarchaeota: nitrogen cycle mein hissa lete hain.

book_ref.quote: The major groups of Archaea include Methanogens

blocks.prompt:
10 What is binary fission in bacteria?
(Bacteria mein binary fission kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Binary fission bacteria ka bunyadi asexual reproduction hai jis mein aik cell taqseem ho kar do aik jaise daughter cells banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Bacteria primarily reproduce asexually through binary fission

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between flagella and pili of bacteria.
(Bacteria ke flagella aur pili mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono satah ke structures hain magar shakal aur kaam alag hai:

book_ref.quote: Many bacteria have one or more flagella, whip-like structures that enable movement

rows: Bohat se bacteria mein aik ya zyada
Satah se chipakne aur genetic material ke tabadle mein madad

blocks.prompt:
12 Name the nutritional modes of bacteria with examples.
(Bacteria ke ghizai tareeqon ke naam misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Autotrophs (khud ghiza banane wale), jaise photosynthetic bacteria; aur heterotrophs (organic maadde par guzara), jaise decomposers.

book_ref.quote: Include autotrophs (self-feeding, e.g., photosynthetic bacteria) and heterotrophs

blocks.prompt:
13 What are extremophile bacteria? Give their types.
(Extremophile bacteria kya hain? Un ki aqsaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh bacteria jo intehai halaat mein panapte hain: thermophiles (zyada temperature), halophiles (zyada namak) aur acidophiles (kam pH).

book_ref.quote: Some bacteria thrive in extreme conditions, such as high temperatures (thermophiles)

blocks.prompt:
14 Give two examples each of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes.
(Proteobacteria aur Firmicutes ki do do misaalen dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Proteobacteria: Escherichia coli, Rhizobium (aur Helicobacter pylori).
Firmicutes: Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus (aur Clostridium botulinum).

book_ref.quote: Proteobacteria e.g., Escherichia coli, Rhizobium, Helicobacter pylori

blocks.prompt:
15 How is the genetic material of eukaryotes organized?
(Eukaryotes ka genetic material kaise tarteeb diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes ka DNA nucleus ke andar kai linear chromosomes mein hota hai aur histone proteins se juda hota hai jo is ki tarteeb aur control mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Their DNA is organized into multiple linear chromosomes within the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
16 How are eukaryotes believed to have originated?
(Khayal hai ke eukaryotes kaise wujood mein aaye?)
blocks.explanation: Endosymbiosis ke zariye: kuch prokaryotic cells (jaise mitochondria aur chloroplasts) ko aik host cell ne nigal liya aur dono mein symbiotic (bahami faide ka) rishta ban gaya.

book_ref.quote: were engulfed by a host cell, leading to a symbiotic relationship

blocks.prompt:
17 What is a taxon? Name the primary levels of the taxonomic hierarchy.
(Taxon kya hai? Taxonomic hierarchy ke bunyadi darjon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Taxon (jama: taxa) biological classification ka aik darja (rank) hai. Domain ke neeche bunyadi darje yeh hain: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus aur species.

book_ref.quote: each representing a rank in the biological classification system

blocks.prompt:
18 Which characters place an animal in class Mammalia? Name its phylum.
(Kaun si khususiyaat kisi janwar ko class Mammalia mein rakhti hain? Is ka phylum batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Class Mammalia, phylum Chordata ke andar, tamam mammals par mushtamil hai jin ki pehchan baal aur mammary glands hain.

book_ref.quote: the class Mammalia includes all mammals, which are characterized by having hair and mammary glands

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between order and family.
(Order aur family mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Order ooncha darja hai; family us ke andar hai:

book_ref.quote: Order categorizes organisms within a class based on additional shared characteristics

rows: Class ke andar organisms ko jama karta hai
Order ke andar organisms ko jama karti hai
Izafi mushtarka khususiyaat aur evolutionary tareekh par
Arkaan aur bhi qareebi, zyada durust mushtarka khususiyaat

blocks.prompt:
20 Write the genus and species of modern humans and of the sparrow.
(Jadeed insaan aur chirya ka genus aur species likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jadeed insaan: genus Homo, species Homo sapiens.
Chirya: genus Passer, species Passer domesticus.

book_ref.quote: the species Homo sapiens refers to modern humans

blocks.text: 1.3 Salient features of the kingdoms of domain Eukarya

blocks.prompt:
21 Name the kingdoms of domain Eukarya. What kind of cells do they have?
(Domain Eukarya ki kingdoms ke naam likhein. In ke cells kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Eukarya mein kingdoms Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia hain. Sab ke cells pechida eukaryotic hain jin mein nucleus aur membrane wale organelles hain.

book_ref.quote: It includes all eukaryotes which consist of complex, eukaryotic cells

blocks.prompt:
22 Define kingdom Protista.
(Kingdom Protista ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kingdom Protista mein woh eukaryotes hain jo unicellular, colonial, filamentous ya simple multicellular hain. Simple multicellular ka matlab hai ke un mein multicellular sex organs nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: Kingdom Protista includes eukaryote which are unicellular or colonial or filamentous or simple multicellular

blocks.prompt:
23 Name three diseases caused by parasitic protists, with their causative agents.
(Parasitic protists se hone wali teen bimariyan un ke asbaab ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Malaria: Plasmodium.
Amoebic dysentery: Entamoeba histolytica.
Sleeping sickness: Trypanosoma.

book_ref.quote: Certain protists are parasitic and cause diseases like malaria

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between protozoa and fungi-like protists.
(Protozoa aur fungi jaise protists mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono protists hain, magar:

book_ref.quote: They are unicellular and are heterotrophic

rows: Misalein: slime molds aur water molds

blocks.prompt:
25 How is the nutrition of fungi unique?
(Fungi ki ghiza ka tareeqa munfarid kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fungi heterotrophs hain magar janwaron aur kuch protists ki tarah khana nigalte nahi; woh mahol se khana jazb karte hain (absorptive heterotrophs).

book_ref.quote: They do not ingest food like animals and some protists

blocks.prompt:
26 Give two uses of fungi.
(Fungi ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Kuch fungi roti (bread), cheese aur beer banane mein istemal hote hain.
2. Kuch dawai khususiyaat rakhte hain, jaise fungus Penicillium se antibiotic penicillin.

book_ref.quote: Some fungi are used in the production of bread, cheese and beer

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between Zygomycota and Basidiomycota.
(Zygomycota aur Basidiomycota mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In ki hyphae aur misaalon mein farq hai:

book_ref.quote: Examples are Rhizopus (bread molds), which grow on moist bread, fruits etc.

rows: Misaal: Rhizopus (bread mold) geeli roti, phalon par
Misalein: mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly fungi, bracket fungi, rusts, smuts

blocks.prompt:
28 Write four characteristics of kingdom Plantae.
(Kingdom Plantae ki chaar khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Paude eukaryotic aur multicellular hain; un ki cell wall cellulose ki hai; woh autotrophic hain aur photosynthesis (zia talifi amal) se khana banate hain; tamam paude embryos se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: They are autotrophic and prepare food through photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between nonvascular and vascular plants.
(Nonvascular aur vascular paudon mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein conducting tissues ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: Examples include liverworts, hornworts, and mosses

rows: Seedless aur seed mein taqseem nahi
Do qisam: seedless aur seed plants
Misalein: ferns (seedless); conifers, phoolon wale paude (seed)

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between the nutrition of fungi and animals.
(Fungi aur janwaron ki ghiza mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono heterotrophs hain, magar:

book_ref.quote: This kingdom of eukaryotes includes animals which are eukaryotic, multicellular and heterotrophic

rows: Mahol se khana jazb karte hain
Khana nigal kar jism ke andar hazam karte hain

blocks.prompt:
31 Differentiate between ostia and osculum.
(Ostia aur osculum mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sponge ki body wall ke surakh hain:

book_ref.quote: There are numerous pores in body wall called ostia

rows: Body wall mein bohat se chhote surakh
In se paani jism mein daakhil hota hai
Is se paani jism se nikalta hai

blocks.prompt:
32 What kind of skeleton do sponges have?
(Sponges ka skeleton kis qisam ka hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sponges ka skeleton calcium carbonate ya silica ki bareek suiyon ki shakal mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: They have skeleton in the form of minute needles of calcium carbonate or silica

blocks.prompt:
33 How is a commercial sponge prepared?
(Commercial (bazaari) sponge kaise tayyar kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Commercial sponge ko sukha kar, peet kar aur dho kar tayyar kiya jata hai yahan tak ke us ke tamam cells nikal jayen.

book_ref.quote: A commercial sponge is prepared by drying, beating, and washing a sponge

blocks.prompt:
34 Why are cnidarians called diploblastic?
(Cnidarians ko diploblastic kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke adult jism mein do tissue layers hain: epidermis (ectoderm se) aur gastrodermis (endoderm se). Un ke darmiyan jelly jaisi mesoglea hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: derived from ectoderm and endoderm respectively

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between polyp and medusa.
(Polyp aur medusa mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh cnidarians ki do jismani shakalen hain:

book_ref.quote: Polyps are cylindrical and are attached to a substrate at the aboral end

rows: Aboral sire se kisi satah se chipka hua

blocks.prompt:
36 What is the gastrovascular cavity of cnidarians?
(Cnidarians ki gastrovascular cavity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aik band sire wali cavity (enteron) hai jo aik hi surakh, munh, se bahar khulti hai; munh hi anus ka kaam karta hai. Munh ke gird tentacles hote hain. Yeh sac-like digestive system hai.

book_ref.quote: Cnidarians have a blind-ending cavity, called gastrovascular cavity or enteron

blocks.prompt:
37 What is the role of flame cells in flatworms?
(Flatworms mein flame cells ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Flame cells protonephridia ki shakhon ke siron par bulb jaise cells hain. In ke cilia hil kar ird gird ka fluid tubules mein kheenchte hain; tubules fuzla chhaan kar nephridiopore se nikalti hain.

book_ref.quote: The cilia of flame cells beat to suck surrounding fluid into the tubules

blocks.prompt:
38 How do flatworms reproduce asexually?
(Flatworms asexual reproduction kaise karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fission se: janwar beech se sukarta hai aur do tukron mein bat jata hai; har tukra apna gum hissa dobara bana leta hai (regeneration).

book_ref.quote: Flatworms reproduce asexually by

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between sac-like and tube-like digestive systems.
(Sac-like aur tube-like digestive systems mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein surakhon ki tadaad ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: It consists of an alimentary canal with two openings

rows: Khane aur fuzle ke liye aik hi surakh (munh)
Do surakhon wali alimentary canal: munh (aage) aur anus (peechhe)

blocks.prompt:
40 What are sensory papillae?
(Sensory papillae kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sensory papillae nematodes (roundworms) ke honton par ubhre hue baal jaise hiss ke organs hain.

book_ref.quote: They have raised hair-like sense organ called sensory papillae, present on lips

blocks.prompt:
41 What are the mantle and mantle cavity of molluscs?
(Molluscs ka mantle aur mantle cavity kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mantle visceral mass ke gird epithelial ghilaf hai; zyada tar molluscs mein is ki bahari satah calcareous shell banati hai. Mantle aur visceral mass ke darmiyan jagah mantle cavity hai.

book_ref.quote: The space between mantle and visceral mass is called as mantle cavity

blocks.prompt:
42 What is an open-type circulatory system?
(Open-type circulatory system kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aisa nizam jis mein khoon vessels mein nahi rehta balke seedha tissue spaces (sinuses) mein cells ko nehlata hai. Cephalopods ke ilawa tamam molluscs mein yeh hai.

book_ref.quote: Rather, it directly bathes cells in tissue spaces (sinuses)

blocks.prompt:
43 Name the three body parts of a mollusc. What does the visceral mass contain?
(Mollusc ke jism ke teen hisse batayein. Visceral mass mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Head, visceral mass aur foot (visceral mass se juda). Visceral mass mein hazme, ikhraj aur reproduction ke organs hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Their body can be divided into three parts i.e., head, visceral mass

blocks.prompt:
44 What are septa in annelids?
(Annelids mein septa kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Septa woh aar paar deewaren hain jo annelids ke jism ke segments ko andar se aik doosre se alag karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Internally, the segments are separated from each other by cross walls called septa

blocks.prompt:
45 Why are annelids so called?
(Annelids ko yeh naam kyun diya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: 'Annelid' ka matlab 'chhota chhalla' hai. In ke segments bahar se jism ki satah par chhote chhallon jaisi sukarahat se nazar aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The segments are indicated externally by constrictions of the body surface

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between the circulatory systems of annelids and arthropods.
(Annelids aur arthropods ke circulatory systems mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik closed aur doosra open hai:

book_ref.quote: They possess a closed-type circulatory system

rows: Open-type: khoon zyada tar hemocoel mein

blocks.prompt:
47 Where is the coelom present in arthropods?
(Arthropods mein coelom kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Arthropods mein coelom kam ho gaya hai aur sirf reproductive aur excretory systems ke gird hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The coelom is reduced and is present only around reproductive and excretory systems

blocks.prompt:
48 Give four functions of the jointed appendages of arthropods.
(Arthropods ke jore daar appendages ke chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jore daar appendages daurne, rengne, tairne, shikar pakarne, saans aur reproduction ke liye badle hue hain; munh ke gird wale mouth parts banate hain.

book_ref.quote: They have jointed appendages which are modified for specialized functions

blocks.prompt:
49 What are Malpighian tubules?
(Malpighian tubules kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh arthropods ke excretory organs hain: alimentary canal se nikli patli tubules jo midgut aur hindgut ke milap par lagi hain. Nitrogen wala fuzla solid uric acid crystals ki shakal mein nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The nitrogenous wastes are excreted in the form of solid uric acid crystals

blocks.prompt:
50 What type of radial symmetry do adult echinoderms show?
(Adult echinoderms kis qisam ki radial symmetry dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Adult echinoderms mein jism ke hisse oral-aboral axis ke gird paanch ya paanch ke multiples mein lage hote hain. (In ke larva bilateral hote hain.)

book_ref.quote: the body parts are arranged in five, or multiple of five, around an oral-aboral axis

blocks.prompt:
51 What are tube feet? How do they help in movement?
(Tube feet kya hain? Yeh harkat mein kaise madad dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tube feet water-vascular system ke phelao hain jo lateral canals ke siron par hain. Yeh phail kar satah se chipakte hain; paani wapas khinchne par sukarte hain aur jism aage khinchta hai.

book_ref.quote: Tube feet are the extensions of water vascular system

blocks.prompt:
52 How do sea stars and brittle stars protect themselves when attacked?
(Hamle ke waqt sea stars aur brittle stars apni hifazat kaise karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hamle ke waqt woh jism ke kuch hisse chhor dete hain aur phir gum hisse dobara bana lete hain (regeneration).

book_ref.quote: drop various parts when they are under attack and then regenerate the lost parts

blocks.prompt:
53 What are pharyngeal slits? What do they become in fishes?
(Pharyngeal slits kya hain? Machhliyon mein yeh kya ban jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pharyngeal slits pharynx ki side wali deewaron mein surakhon ka silsila hain; tamam chordates ke embryo mein gill slits ke joray bante hain. Amphioxus aur machhliyon mein yeh gills ban jati hain.

book_ref.quote: These are a series of openings in the lateral walls of pharynx

blocks.prompt:
54 What is a post-anal tail?
(Post-anal tail kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh dum jo tamam chordates mein anus ke surakh se peechhe banti hai. Kuch chordates mein saari zindagi rehti hai aur kuch mein embryo ki zindagi mein khatam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: All chordates develop a tail, posteriorly beyond the anal opening

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between Urochordata and Cephalochordata.
(Urochordata aur Cephalochordata mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono invertebrate chordates hain:

book_ref.quote: in which notochord persists throughout life

rows: Notochord aur nerve cord sirf aazad tairne wale larva mein

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between group Pisces and group Tetrapoda.
(Group Pisces aur group Tetrapoda mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Vertebrates in do groups mein taqseem hain:

book_ref.quote: Group Pisces: It includes 3 classes

blocks.prompt:
57 Give four characteristics of class Cyclostomata.
(Class Cyclostomata ki chaar khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jabron ke baghair machhliyan (lampreys, hagfish), jism eel jaisa aur scales ke baghair; cartilage ka skeleton; single-circuit dil, aik atrium aur aik ventricle; bahari fertilization.

book_ref.quote: Their bodies are eel-like and not covered with scales

blocks.prompt:
58 What are spiracles in cartilaginous fishes?
(Cartilaginous machhliyon mein spiracles kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cartilaginous machhliyon (sharks, rays) mein aankhon ke peechhe chhote surakhon ka jora jo saans ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: There is a pair of small openings, called spiracle, behind eyes

blocks.prompt:
59 Differentiate between Chondrichthyes and Osteichthyes.
(Chondrichthyes aur Osteichthyes mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jabron wali machhliyon ki do classes mein farq:

book_ref.quote: Notochord is replaced by vertebral column

rows: Operculum nahi; aankhon ke peechhe spiracles
Operculum gills ki hifazat karta hai

blocks.prompt:
60 How does the neck of amphibians help them?
(Amphibians ki gardan un ki kya madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Machhliyon ke bar-aks amphibians ki gardan hai. Pehli (cervical) vertebra khopri ke peechhe harkat karti hai aur sar ko oopar neeche hilane deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Unlike fishes, amphibians have a neck

blocks.prompt:
61 Give the functions of the skin of amphibians.
(Amphibians ki jild ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hamwar (bina scales) geeli jild gas exchange, temperature control aur paani jazb aur jama karne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps in gas exchange, temperature regulation, and absorption and storage of water

blocks.prompt:
62 Differentiate between ectotherms and endotherms.
(Ectotherms aur endotherms mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein jism ki garmi ke zariye ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: They depend on external heat source and so are ectotherms

rows: Cells ke amal se garmi hasil karte hain
Jism ka temperature yaksan nahi rakh sakte (poikilotherms)

blocks.prompt:
63 Name the extra-embryonic membranes of the amniotic egg and give their role.
(Amniotic egg ki extra-embryonic membranes ke naam aur kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Amnion, allantois aur chorion. Yeh embryo ko sookhne se bachati, ghiza deti aur khushki par nashonuma mumkin banati hain.

book_ref.quote: These membranes protect the embryo from drying out

blocks.prompt:
64 Give two skeletal differences of reptiles from amphibians.
(Reptiles ke skeleton ke amphibians se do farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Reptiles ka bony endoskeleton amphibians se sakht aur khopri lambi hai; reptiles mein pehli do cervical vertebrae (atlas aur axis) sar ko zyada harkat deti hain.

book_ref.quote: The bony endoskeleton of reptiles is harder than amphibians

blocks.prompt:
65 Write the functions of feathers.
(Paron (feathers) ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Par urne ki satah banate hain jo lift dete aur rukh badalne mein madad karte hain; yeh garmi aur paani ke zayaa hone ko bhi rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: Feathers form the flight surfaces that provide lift and aid in steering

blocks.prompt:
66 What is the keel? Why are bird bones light?
(Keel kya hai? Parindon ki haddiyan halki kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Keel sternum (seene ki haddi) par bari haddi hai jis se urne ke muscles jurte hain. Parindon ki haddiyan bare hawai khanon ki wajah se halki hain.

book_ref.quote: The sternum (chest bone) bears a large, bone called keel

blocks.prompt:
67 Differentiate between crop and gizzard.
(Crop aur gizzard mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono parinde ki khurak ki nali ke hisse hain:

book_ref.quote: is a storage structure that allows birds to quickly ingest large quantities of food

rows: Parinde jaldi zyada khana nigal sakte hain

blocks.prompt:
68 What is the diaphragm of mammals?
(Mammals ka diaphragm kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diaphragm mammals mein muscular parda hai jo coelom ko thoracic (seene) aur abdominal (pait) cavities mein taqseem karta hai.

book_ref.quote: They have a muscular diaphragm that separates the coelom into thoracic and abdominal cavities

blocks.prompt:
69 Name the two sets of teeth of mammals and the parts of their voice apparatus.
(Mammals ke daanton ke do set aur awaz ke aalaat ke hisse batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar mammals ke doodh ke daant aur pakke daant hote hain. Un ka awaz ka aala larynx (vocal cords ke saath) aur epiglottis hai.

book_ref.quote: Most mammals have two sets of teeth during their lives

blocks.prompt:
70 Differentiate between marsupials and placental mammals.
(Marsupials aur placental mammals mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono viviparous hain (book correction: marsupials viviparous hain, ovoviviparous nahi), magar:

book_ref.quote: These mammals give birth to immature young ones which complete their development

rows: Adhoore bachche paida, thaili mein nashonuma mukammal
Foetus uterus mein placenta se ghiza le kar poora banta hai
Misalein: dolphin, rat, monkey, bat, elephant, insaan

blocks.prompt:
71 Differentiate between prions and viroids.
(Prions aur viroids mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono acellular infectious zarrat hain, jaandaar organisms nahi:

book_ref.quote: Prions are composed of protein only

rows: Janwaron aur insanon mein bimari (jaise scrapie, mad cow disease, Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease)
Kuch paudon mein bimari (jaise potato spindle tuber disease)

blocks.prompt:
72 What is the structure of a virus? Why does it depend on a host cell?
(Virus ki banawat kya hai? Yeh host cell par kyun inhisar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Virus nucleic acid (DNA ya RNA) par mushtamil hai jis ke gird protein ka khol hai. Yeh khud koi metabolism nahi chala sakta, is liye nakal banane aur protein banane ke liye host cell (paude, janwar ya bacterium) par inhisar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: They cannot run any metabolism and depend upon the host cell

blocks.prompt:
73 Name the characteristics used to classify viruses.
(Viruses ki classification mein istemal hone wali khususiyaat ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Un ka genetic material, replication ka tareeqa, shakal (morphology) aur jin hosts ko woh infect karte hain; ICTV ke usoolon ke mutabiq.

book_ref.quote: Viruses are classified based on several characteristics

blocks.prompt:
74 Give one example each of a plant virus and an animal virus.
(Plant virus aur animal virus ki aik aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Plant virus: tobacco mosaic virus (ya potato virus X).
Animal virus: influenza virus (ya rabies virus).

book_ref.quote: Plant Viruses: Infect plants

blocks.prompt:
75 Differentiate between helical and complex viruses.
(Helical aur complex viruses mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In ke capsid ki banawat mein farq hai:

book_ref.quote: These have a capsid with a helical structure surrounding the nucleic acid

rows: Nucleic acid ke gird helical capsid
Pechida banawat, aksar icosahedral aur helical dono
Misalein: tobacco mosaic virus, rabies virus

blocks.prompt:
76 Differentiate between enveloped and non-enveloped viruses.
(Enveloped aur non-enveloped viruses mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In ke bahari ghilaf mein farq hai:

book_ref.quote: These lack an outer lipid envelope and consist only of a capsid enclosing the nucleic acid

rows: Capsid ke gird host cell membrane se bana lipid ghilaf
Lipid ghilaf nahi; sirf nucleic acid ke gird capsid

blocks.prompt:
77 Differentiate between positive-sense and negative-sense RNA viruses.
(Positive-sense aur negative-sense RNA viruses mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein genome se protein banne ke tareeqe ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: The RNA genome is directly translated into proteins by the host cell

rows: RNA genome seedha host ribosomes par protein mein translate hota hai
RNA genome pehle viral RNA polymerase se mRNA banta hai, phir translation

blocks.prompt:
78 What are reverse transcribing viruses? Give two examples.
(Reverse transcribing viruses kya hain? Do misaalen dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh viruses jo reverse transcriptase enzyme se DNA intermediate bana kar nakal banate hain; in ka genome RNA ya DNA ho sakta hai. Misalein: HIV (retrovirus, RNA genome, AIDS karta hai) aur hepatitis B virus (hepadnavirus, DNA genome).

book_ref.quote: RNA genome: Retroviruses like HIV (cause AIDS)

blocks.prompt:
79 Define biodiversity.
(Biodiversity ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Biodiversity ('biological diversity' se) mukhtalif ecosystems mein zindagi ki shakalon ki rangarangi hai, jis mein species, genes aur ecosystems ki diversity shamil hai. Yeh organisms ki kasrat aur un ke aapas aur mahol se rishton ko zahir karti hai.

book_ref.quote: refers to the variety of life forms present in different ecosystems

blocks.prompt:
80 What does species diversity include?
(Species diversity mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Species diversity mein na sirf kisi ilaqe ki species ki tadaad balke un ki nisbati kasrat aur phelao bhi shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: Species diversity includes not only the number of species but also their relative abundance and distribution

blocks.prompt:
81 What is genetic diversity? Why is it important?
(Genetic diversity kya hai? Yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Genetic diversity kisi species ke tamam afraad mein genetic maloomat ki rangarangi hai. Yeh species ki mutabiqat aur baqa ke liye zaroori hai taake woh mahol ki tabdeeliyon ka muqabla kar sake.

book_ref.quote: biodiversity refers to the variety of genetic information contained within all individual organisms of a species

blocks.prompt:
82 Give two ways in which random sampling helps biodiversity studies.
(Random sampling biodiversity ke mutaale mein kin do tareeqon se madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Qabil-e-aitmaad andaze: data ka statistical tajziya kar ke species richness, kasrat aur phelao ka andaza lagaya jata hai.
2. Yaksan tareeqe se data jama kar ke mukhtalif ilaqon ya habitats ka muqabla mumkin hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It enables comparisons between different areas or habitats

blocks.prompt:
83 Differentiate between quadrat sampling and transect sampling.
(Quadrat sampling aur transect sampling mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono phelao ka andaza lagate hain, magar:

book_ref.quote: It involves dividing the study area into a grid and sampling within randomly selected squares

rows: Ilaqa grid mein taqseem; random squares mein sampling
Ilaqe mein line ya patti; baqaida faslon par species record
Paudon ya sessile organisms ke liye mufeed
Mukhtalif mahol mein species ke phelao ke liye mufeed
Misaal: jangal mein quadrats mein paude record karna
Misaal: sahil par high tide se low tide line

blocks.prompt:
84 What is the quadrat count method?
(Quadrat count method kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kasrat ka andaza lagane ka tareeqa jis mein har quadrat mein species ke afraad gine jate hain aur un ginti se kul kasrat ka andaza lagaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: researchers use quadrats to count the number of individuals of a species within each quadrat

blocks.prompt:
85 What do members of the same species share?
(Aik hi species ke arkaan mein kya mushtarak hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik species ke arkaan qudrati halaat mein aapas mein nasl barha kar zarkhez aulad paida kar sakte hain; un ki mushtarka khususiyaat aur genetic banawat unhen doosri species se alag karti hai.

book_ref.quote: A species is generally defined as a group of individuals that can interbreed and produce fertile offspring under natural conditions

blocks.prompt:
86 Why can identifying species by physical traits be problematic?
(Physical traits se species ki pehchan kyun mushkil ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cryptic species ki wajah se: aise organisms jo dekhne mein aik jaise magar genetically alag hain. Is liye Ernst Mayr ne reproductive isolation ko bunyadi kasauti banaya.

book_ref.quote: Identification of species by using physical traits and similarities can sometimes be problematic

blocks.prompt:
87 Define speciation.
(Speciation ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Speciation woh evolutionary amal hai jis se mushtarka jadd se nayi species banti hain. Is mein genetic tabdeeliyan jama hoti hain jo aabaadiyon ke darmiyan reproductive isolation paida karti hain.

book_ref.quote: It involves the accumulation of genetic changes that lead to reproductive isolation between populations

blocks.prompt:
88 What is peripatric speciation? Give an example.
(Peripatric speciation kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Bari aabaadi ke kinare par chhoti, alag aabaadi mein speciation; chhoti aabaadi tezi se badalti aur alag ho jati hai. Misaal: chhoti bani aabaadi se island species.

book_ref.quote: The small population undergoes rapid evolutionary changes

blocks.prompt:
89 Differentiate between parapatric and peripatric speciation.
(Parapatric aur peripatric speciation mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono speciation ke tareeqe hain, magar:

book_ref.quote: This occurs when populations are adjacent to each other but occupy different environments along a gradient

rows: Saath saath aabaadiyan, gradient par mukhtalif mahol
Bari aabaadi ke kinare chhoti alag aabaadi
Gene flow kam; apne mahol ke mutabiq dhalna
Chhoti aabaadi mein tez evolutionary tabdeeli
Misaal: ghaas Anthoxanthum odoratum mukhtalif mitti par
Misaal: chhoti bani aabaadi se island species

blocks.prompt:
90 What is niche differentiation in sympatric speciation?
(Sympatric speciation mein niche differentiation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Niche differentiation sympatric speciation ka tareeqa hai jis mein aik hi ilaqe ki mukhtalif zaili aabaadiyan alag alag wasail istemal karti hain aur baghair physical rukawat ke nayi species ban jati hain.

book_ref.quote: where different subpopulations exploit different resources
